user.title: Choose connection mode
user.description: Choose how to connect to your Arctic Spas hot tub.

data_description.mode: Direct connects to the spa over your local network (no internet required). Cloud connects via the My Arctic Spa portal using your login credentials.

direct.title: Direct Connection
direct.description: Enter your spa's local IP address. Connects directly to the spa over your local network. A DHCP reservation is recommended.

cloud.title: Cloud Connection
cloud.description: Enter your My Arctic Spa portal credentials (dealer.myarcticspa.com).

cloud_select_spa.title: Select Spa
cloud_select_spa.description: Your account has multiple spas. Choose which one to add.

reconfigure_direct.title: Update Spa IP Address
reconfigure_direct.description: Enter the spa's new local IP address. A DHCP reservation is recommended to prevent future changes.

reconfigure_cloud.title: Update Cloud Credentials
reconfigure_cloud.description: Enter your updated My Arctic Spa portal credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to spa. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check and try again.
error.no_spas: No spas found on this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Arctic Spas hot tub is already configured.
